answer: To deter Sybil swarms, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Sybil defense is no mythological fable: each concurrent pseudonymous clone incurs exponential capital exhaustion, requiring an unfeasible spiral of stake scaling like $O(2^n)$ across the cluster. Attackers find their assets drained into a liquidity lagoon, making mass identity spoofing mathematically unviable.
